Uns CNY 55 a 70 pelo parque, e a nota honesta e que a melhor vista e de fora, do calcadao da Rua Binjiang, de graca - decida no portao se o lado de dentro vale para voce. Uma hora e de sobra.

items.address: Elephant Trunk Hill, Binjiang Road, Xiangshan District, Guilin · 桂林市象山区滨江路象鼻山

text.en: Long lunch in Guilin
text.pt: Almoco longo em Guilin

note.en: The last unhurried meal before three weeks turn into an airport and a night flight. Guilin rice noodles again if you want the cheap right answer, or the Yiren Road pedestrian street a few minutes north for something sit-down. Eat properly - the food after security at KWL is thin and you land in Beijing at 00:40.
note.pt: A ultima refeicao sem pressa antes de tres semanas virarem um aeroporto e um voo noturno. Macarrao de arroz de Guilin de novo se voce quiser a resposta certa e barata, ou a rua de pedestres Yiren alguns minutos ao norte para algo sentado. Coma direito - a comida depois da seguranca no KWL e escassa e voce pousa em Pequim as 00:40.

items.address: Yiren Road Pedestrian Street, Xiufeng District, Guilin · 桂林市秀峰区依仁路步行街

text.en: Reed Flute Cave (drop it if you would rather not)
text.pt: Gruta da Flauta de Junco (corte se preferir)

note.en: A 240 m walking route through a limestone cavern of stalactites and stone curtains, lit in colour, with a mirror pool at the end that doubles the whole chamber. About CNY 90 to 110. The name comes from the reeds at the mouth that were cut into flutes; the ink inscriptions on the walls go back to the Tang dynasty. The straight assessment: it is well done, and it is also the second lit cave of this trip after Yellow Dragon in Zhangjiajie, which was bigger and had an underground river. If the day has been enough already, spend the 90 minutes on the Li embankment instead and go to the airport early - nothing is lost.
note.pt: Um percurso a pe de 240 m por uma caverna de calcario com estalactites e cortinas de pedra, iluminada em cores, com um lago-espelho no fim que duplica a camara inteira. Uns CNY 90 a 110. O nome vem dos juncos da boca da gruta, que eram cortados em flautas; as inscricoes a tinta nas paredes remontam a dinastia Tang. A avaliacao direta: e bem feita, e e tambem a segunda caverna iluminada desta viagem depois da do Dragao Amarelo em Zhangjiajie, que era maior e tinha rio subterraneo. Se o dia ja tiver bastado, gaste os 90 minutos na beira do Li e va cedo para o aeroporto - nao se perde nada.

items.address: Reed Flute Cave, Ludi Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin · 桂林市秀峰区芦笛路芦笛岩

text.en: Guilin city to Guilin airport (KWL)
text.pt: Cidade de Guilin ate o aeroporto de Guilin (KWL)

note.en: About 28 km west, 35 to 45 minutes by car, roughly CNY 100 to 130 - much easier than the 1h45 it would have been from Yangshuo, which is the quiet reason the circuit ends in the city. Leave a wide margin anyway: this is the one flight you cannot miss. Eat before you go.
note.pt: Uns 28 km a oeste, 35 a 45 minutos de carro, uns CNY 100 a 130 - bem mais facil do que a 1h45 que seria a partir de Yangshuo, e essa e a razao silenciosa de o circuito terminar na cidade. Ainda assim deixe margem larga: este e o voo que voce nao pode perder. Coma antes de ir.

items.address: Guilin Liangjiang International Airport · 桂林两江国际机场

to.name: Guilin Liangjiang KWL 桂林两江国际机场

text.en: Flight Guilin KWL to Beijing
text.pt: Voo Guilin KWL ate Pequim

note.en: The cheap night flight the whole route was rebuilt around: about 3 hours in the air, landing in Beijing around 00:40. Confirm the exact flight, the 2026 time and whether it lands at Daxing (PKX) or Capital (PEK) when you book. You reach the hotel near 01:30, which is why tomorrow starts late by design.
note.pt: O voo noturno barato em torno do qual a rota inteira foi refeita: cerca de 3 horas de voo, pousando em Pequim por volta das 00:40. Confirme o voo exato, o horario de 2026 e se pousa em Daxing (PKX) ou Capital (PEK) ao reservar. Voce chega ao hotel perto da 01:30, e por isso amanha comeca tarde de proposito.

items.address: Beijing Daxing PKX · 北京大兴国际机场

from.name: Guilin Liangjiang KWL 桂林两江国际机场

to.name: Beijing Daxing PKX 北京大兴国际机场

note.en: Oct 23 (Fri) - Landed in the small hours, and the day is built around the one thing that cannot move: the Forbidden City sells no same-day tickets, releases them 7 days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time on dpm.org.cn, ties each ticket to a passport, and closes on Mondays. So book it now for this date, then let the day run down the imperial axis on foot: palace, the hill that looks back over it, the towers north of it, and the Temple of Heaven to the south, whose halls shut at 17:30 even though the park stays open until 22:00. It is the fullest day in Beijing. If the 00:40 landing has wrecked you, the Drum and Bell towers are the part to cut.
note.pt: 23/out (sex) - Vocês pousaram de madrugada, e o dia se organiza em torno da unica coisa que nao se move: a Cidade Proibida nao vende ingresso no dia, libera os bilhetes 7 dias antes as 20:00 de Pequim no dpm.org.cn, amarra cada ingresso a um passaporte e fecha nas segundas. Reserve agora para esta data e deixe o dia descer o eixo imperial a pe: palacio, a colina que o olha de cima, as torres ao norte e o Templo do Ceu ao sul, cujos pavilhoes fecham as 17:30 mesmo que o parque fique aberto ate as 22:00. E o dia mais cheio de Pequim. Se o pouso as 00:40 acabou com voces, a parte a cortar sao as torres do Tambor e do Sino.

text.en: Arrive from Guilin, taxi to the hotel
text.pt: Chegada de Guilin, taxi ate o hotel

note.en: The night flight from Guilin lands around 00:40. Baggage and a taxi put you at the hotel by roughly 01:30 - just sleep. The airport is about an hour out; a Didi booked before you land beats a 01:00 taxi queue.
note.pt: O voo noturno de Guilin pousa por volta das 00:40. Bagagem e taxi te poem no hotel la pela 01:30 - so durma. O aeroporto fica a cerca de uma hora; um Didi reservado antes de pousar ganha da fila de taxi da 1h da manha.

items.address: Beijing Daxing PKX · 北京大兴国际机场

from.name: Beijing Daxing PKX 北京大兴国际机场

text.en: To the Meridian Gate, the south entrance
text.pt: Ate o Meridian Gate, a entrada sul

note.en: The only way in is the Meridian Gate (Wumen), on the south side, and only with the original passport used for the booking. Coming from the north hutongs it is about 15 minutes by taxi. There is a security check before Tiananmen Square, so allow for a queue and do not cut this to the minute.
note.pt: So se entra pelo Meridian Gate (Wumen), do lado sul, e so com o passaporte original usado na reserva. Vindo dos hutongs do norte sao uns 15 minutos de taxi. Tem revista de seguranca antes da praca Tiananmen, entao conte com fila e nao deixe isso no limite do horario.

items.address: Meridian Gate, Dongcheng District · 北京市东城区午门

text.en: The Forbidden City, Meridian Gate to Shenwumen
text.pt: A Cidade Proibida, do Meridian Gate ao Shenwumen

note.en: Nine thousand rooms on a single north-south axis, home to the Ming and Qing emperors for almost five centuries. Walk the central axis first while it is still empty: the three great halls one behind the other, then the inner court. Then cut off the axis into the side palaces, which is where the rooms get small, furnished and human, and where almost nobody goes. The Treasure Gallery and the Clock Gallery cost extra and are worth it. Open 08:30 to 17:00 through 31 Oct, last admission 16:00, closed on Mondays. Three and a half hours is the honest minimum.
note.pt: Nove mil comodos num unico eixo norte-sul, casa dos imperadores Ming e Qing por quase cinco seculos. Percorra o eixo central primeiro, enquanto ainda esta vazio: os tres grandes saloes um atras do outro, depois a corte interna. Depois saia do eixo para os palacios laterais, que e onde os comodos ficam pequenos, mobiliados e humanos, e onde quase ninguem vai. A Galeria do Tesouro e a Galeria dos Relogios custam a parte e valem. Aberto das 08:30 as 17:00 ate 31/out, ultima entrada 16:00, fechado as segundas. Tres horas e meia e o minimo honesto.

items.address: 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District · 北京市东城区景山前街4号

text.en: Lunch by the north gate
text.pt: Almoco perto do portao norte

note.en: You come out at Shenwumen, on Jingshan Front Street, with the moat on your left. There are ordinary noodle and dumpling places a couple of blocks east toward Beichizi. Eat before the hill, not after.
note.pt: Voce sai no Shenwumen, na Jingshan Front Street, com o fosso a esquerda. Tem lugares comuns de macarrao e guioza um par de quarteiroes a leste, na direcao de Beichizi. Coma antes da colina, nao depois.

text.en: Jingshan Park, the view from the hill
text.pt: Jingshan Park, a vista do alto

note.en: Straight across the street from the exit. An artificial hill built from the earth dug out of the palace moat, and a ten-minute climb to the Wanchun Pavilion at the top, which looks straight down the axis you just walked: the entire Forbidden City in one frame, golden roof after golden roof. This is the picture everyone means when they say they have seen the Forbidden City.
note.pt: Bem do outro lado da rua, na saida. Uma colina artificial feita com a terra escavada do fosso do palacio, e uma subida de dez minutos ate o Pavilhao Wanchun no topo, que olha direto pelo eixo que voce acabou de andar: a Cidade Proibida inteira num quadro so, telhado dourado atras de telhado dourado. E essa a foto que todo mundo quer dizer quando diz que viu a Cidade Proibida.

items.address: 44 Jingshan West Street, Xicheng District · 北京市西城区景山西街44号

text.en: Drum Tower and Bell Tower
text.pt: Drum Tower e Bell Tower

note.en: Placed here on purpose: squeezed onto the arrival day it would have been a 30-minute sprint against the 17:20 last entry, and this deserves better. With the Forbidden City skipped, the view from the top over the grey hutong roofs is the traveller's one panorama of the old imperial city - it is the compensation, not a filler. Peak season (Apr 26 - Oct 25) 09:30-17:30, last entry 17:20; same-day online sales close 15:30, so buy ahead. Bell Tower 150 m north. Low effort, high reward, perfect for a tired afternoon.
note.pt: Posto aqui de proposito: espremido no dia da chegada, teria virado um sprint de 30 minutos contra a ultima entrada das 17h20, e isto merece melhor. Com a Cidade Proibida pulada, a vista do topo sobre os telhados cinza dos hutongs e o unico panorama que o viajante tera da cidade imperial antiga - e a compensacao, nao enchimento. Alta temporada (26/abr a 25/out) 9h30-17h30, ultima entrada 17h20; venda online no mesmo dia fecha 15h30, entao compre antes. Bell Tower 150 m ao norte. Pouco esforco, muita recompensa, perfeito para uma tarde cansada.

items.address: No. 9 Zhonglouwan Linzi Hutong, Dongcheng District · 东城区钟楼湾临字9号

text.en: Qianmen Street and Dashilan
text.pt: Rua Qianmen e Dashilan

note.en: The old commercial spine straight south of Tian'anmen, rebuilt but still the place Beijing shopped for four centuries. Dashilan, the lane running west off it, is the better half: narrower, older, full of century-old shops.
note.pt: A espinha comercial antiga logo ao sul de Tian'anmen, reconstruida mas ainda o lugar onde Pequim fez compras por quatro seculos. Dashilan, o beco que sai dela para oeste, e a metade melhor: mais estreito, mais antigo, cheio de lojas centenarias.

items.address: Qianmen Street, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区前门大街

text.en: Dashilan lane, west off Qianmen
text.pt: Beco Dashilan, a oeste da Qianmen

items.address: Dashilan Street, Xicheng · 北京市西城区大栅栏街

text.en: Temple of Heaven
text.pt: Templo do Ceu

note.en: Coming back north from the pandas, the Temple of Heaven takes the late afternoon. Honest trade: its real magic is at dawn, 06:00-09:00, when a thousand locals fill the cypress groves with tai chi, opera and water calligraphy - and by afternoon that is gone. What is left is the architecture, and it is not small: the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, a wooden rotunda built without a single nail, at its most photogenic in low golden light. Monuments close 17:00; buy the 34-yuan through-ticket, not the 15-yuan park-only, or you cannot enter the Hall. Metro line 5, Tiantandongmen.
note.pt: Voltando para o norte depois dos pandas, o Templo do Ceu fica com o fim da tarde. Troca honesta: a magia de verdade dele e de manha cedo, 6h-9h, quando mil moradores enchem os bosques de ciprestes com tai chi, opera e caligrafia com agua - e a tarde isso ja foi. O que sobra e a arquitetura, e nao e pouca: o Salao de Oracao pelas Boas Colheitas, uma rotunda de madeira erguida sem um unico prego, no seu momento mais fotogenico na luz dourada baixa. Os monumentos fecham as 17h; compre o combinado de 34 yuan, nao a entrada simples de 15, ou voce nao entra no Salao. Metro linha 5, Tiantandongmen.

items.address: No. 1 Tiantan East Road, Dongcheng District · 东城区天坛东路甲1号

text.en: Peking duck
text.pt: Pato laqueado

note.en: The classic Beijing reward after a day on the Wall, and it holds whether you picked Plan A or Plan B. The Gulou area around the Drum Tower has good duck, so you can walk to dinner from the tower rather than crossing the city on tired legs. Deliberately no restaurant named - I have not verified one.
note.pt: A recompensa classica de Pequim depois de um dia na Muralha, e vale tanto para o Plano A quanto para o Plano B. A regiao de Gulou, em volta do Drum Tower, tem bom pato, entao da para ir a pe da torre ate o jantar em vez de atravessar a cidade de perna cansada. De proposito nao indico restaurante - nao verifiquei nenhum.

items.address: Gulou area, Dongcheng District · 东城区鼓楼一带

note.en: Oct 24 (Sat) - THE WALL, AND A DECISION, now on a Saturday, which is exactly why the 05:30 alarm matters: Mutianyu opens 07:30 (18:30 close at weekends, toboggan on the same hours) and the empty window is 07:30 to 09:00, before the coaches arrive. Back in town by early afternoon, the Summer Palace takes the rest of the light: the park gates are open 06:00 to 19:00 and the buildings inside until 17:30, so aim to be at the lake by 15:00. Then the Shichahai lakes at sunset, ten minutes away, and dinner around the water. PLAN B stays on the table: Jinshanling is emptier, but it has no toboggan.
note.pt: 24/out (sab) - A MURALHA, E UMA DECISAO, agora num sabado, e e exatamente por isso que o alarme as 05:30 importa: Mutianyu abre as 07:30 (fecha as 18:30 nos fins de semana, o toboggan no mesmo horario) e a janela vazia vai das 07:30 as 09:00, antes dos onibus. De volta a cidade no comeco da tarde, o Palacio de Verao leva o resto da luz: os portoes do parque abrem 06:00 as 19:00 e os pavilhoes internos ate as 17:30, entao a meta e estar no lago as 15:00. Depois os lagos de Shichahai no por do sol, a dez minutos, e jantar em volta da agua. O PLANO B continua de pe: Jinshanling e mais vazia, mas nao tem toboggan.

text.en: PLAN A - Beijing to Mutianyu, leave 06:00
text.pt: PLANO A - Pequim a Mutianyu, saia 06h00

note.en: The 06:00 departure IS the strategy - it is the whole reason this works, so do not soften it. Private car round trip, roughly 600-800 yuan for the day, gets you to the gate for the 07:30 opening. The public route cannot: metro line 2 to Dongzhimen exit B, bus 916 Express (916快, never the slow regular 916) to Huairou Beidajie 70-90 min, then bus H23/H24/H35/H36 to Mutianyu Roundabout 20 min, total 15-30 yuan - but it puts you at the gate around 09:30, exactly when the buses land, which defeats the entire plan. On this one day, pay for the car.
note.pt: A saida as 06h00 E a estrategia - e a razao inteira de isso funcionar, entao nao amoleca. Carro privado ida e volta, aprox. 600-800 yuan o dia, te poe no portao para a abertura das 7h30. A rota publica nao consegue: metro linha 2 ate Dongzhimen saida B, onibus 916 Express (916快, nunca o 916 comum que e lento) ate Huairou Beidajie 70-90 min, depois onibus H23/H24/H35/H36 ate Mutianyu Huandao 20 min, total 15-30 yuan - mas te deixa no portao la pelas 9h30, exatamente quando os onibus chegam, o que destroi o plano inteiro. Neste dia especifico, pague o carro.

items.address: Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station · 东直门外公交枢纽

text.en: PLAN A - Gate, shuttle and chairlift up to Tower 6
text.pt: PLANO A - Portao, shuttle e chairlift ate a torre 6

note.en: Mutianyu opens 07:30 in peak season (Mar 16 - Nov 15); Oct 24 is a Saturday, but well past Golden Week - and the dawn start is exactly what carries a weekend. Entry 40 yuan, chairlift 100 one way. From the visitor centre the internal shuttle to the lift base is compulsory - you cannot walk it. Take the chairlift, not the enclosed cable car, and get off at Tower 6.
note.pt: Mutianyu abre 7h30 na alta temporada (16/mar a 15/nov); 24/out e um sabado, mas bem depois da Golden Week - e a largada de madrugada e justamente o que segura um fim de semana. Entrada 40 yuan, chairlift 100 so ida. Do centro de visitantes o shuttle interno ate a base do teleferico e obrigatorio - nao da para ir a pe. Pegue o chairlift, nao o teleferico fechado, e desca na torre 6.

items.address: Mutianyu Village, Bohai Town, Huairou District · 怀柔区渤海镇慕田峪村

text.en: PLAN A - Walk the wall in the empty window
text.pt: PLANO A - Caminhe a muralha na janela vazia

note.en: This is the payoff. Sources agree the calm window is 07:30-09:00 on a weekday and that the crowd builds sharply after 09:00, when the day-trip buses arrive. You get roughly ninety minutes of near-solitude and low autumn light, then it fills in around you and you are already ahead of it. Walk east toward Tower 20 for the emptiest stretch - most people never leave the Tower 6 to 14 stub.
note.pt: Esta e a recompensa. As fontes concordam que a janela calma e 7h30-9h em dia de semana e que a multidao engrossa forte depois das 9h, quando chegam os onibus de bate-volta. Voce ganha uns noventa minutos de quase-solidao e luz baixa de outono, e depois ela enche em volta de voce, que ja saiu na frente. Caminhe para leste rumo a torre 20 para o trecho mais vazio - quase ninguem sai do toco entre as torres 6 e 14.

items.address: Mutianyu Great Wall, Towers 6 to 20 · 慕田峪长城 六号楼至二十号楼

text.en: PLAN A - Toboggan down from Tower 6
text.pt: PLANO A - Toboggan descendo da torre 6

note.en: The toboggan is descent only, 100 yuan, 1,580 m of hand-braked stainless track through the forest - the thing that exists nowhere else. The detail that trips everyone up: it leaves from the CHAIRLIFT station at Tower 6, not from the enclosed cable car station at Tower 14, so mixing them costs a 30-45 minute stair climb. Going down at 11:00 also means you beat the queue, which is genuinely long by early afternoon.
note.pt: O toboggan so desce, 100 yuan, 1.580 m de trilho de inox com freio de mao pela mata - a coisa que nao existe em lugar nenhum. O detalhe que derruba todo mundo: ele sai da estacao do CHAIRLIFT na torre 6, nao da estacao do teleferico fechado na torre 14, entao misturar os dois custa 30-45 minutos de escadaria. Descer as 11h tambem significa furar a fila, que fica sinceramente longa no comeco da tarde.

items.address: Mutianyu Great Wall, Tower 6 station · 慕田峪长城 六号楼索道站

text.en: PLAN A - Back to Beijing, rest
text.pt: PLANO A - Volta a Pequim, descanso

note.en: The dawn strategy hands the afternoon back as a bonus: you are home by 13:30 while the buses are still disgorging at the gate. Take a real nap - the Drum Tower is gentle but you woke at 05:30 and walked kilometres of Ming staircase, and tomorrow starts early too.
note.pt: A estrategia da madrugada devolve a tarde de bonus: voce esta em casa as 13h30 enquanto os onibus ainda estao despejando gente no portao. Tire um cochilo de verdade - o Drum Tower e leve, mas voce acordou as 5h30 e caminhou quilometros de escadaria Ming, e amanha tambem comeca cedo.

text.en: Summer Palace
text.pt: Palacio de Verao

note.en: A vast imperial garden around Kunming Lake, open from 06:30 but taken this afternoon after a late start. October gives it the best light of the year; the Long Corridor and Foxiang Ge over the lake are the postcard. Buy the Combination Ticket, not the plain entry. It sits in the far northwest, which is why it pairs with Houhai on the way back toward the centre.
note.pt: Um jardim imperial enorme em volta do Lago Kunming, aberto desde as 06:30 mas pego nesta tarde depois de um comeco tardio. Outubro da a ele a melhor luz do ano; o Long Corridor e o Foxiang Ge sobre o lago sao o cartao-postal. Compre o Combination Ticket, nao a entrada simples. Fica no extremo noroeste, e por isso casa com o Houhai na volta em direcao ao centro.

items.address: No. 19 Xinjiangongmen Road, Haidian District · 海淀区新建宫门路19号

text.en: Shichahai and Houhai at sunset
text.pt: Shichahai e Houhai no por do sol

note.en: Imperial lakes ringed by hutongs, an easy hop from the Summer Palace back toward the centre. Sunset in mid-October falls around 17:45, so you arrive with the light still on the water. Walk the north shore of Houhai and ignore the row of cover-band bars - this is where Beijing still looks like Beijing. It also makes Nanluoguxiang redundant, which is why that one was cut: same hutong idea, done better and for free.
note.pt: Lagos imperiais cercados de hutongs, a um pulo do Palacio de Verao de volta ao centro. O por do sol em meados de outubro cai por volta das 17h45, entao voce chega com a luz ainda na agua. Ande a margem norte do Houhai e ignore a fileira de bares com cover band - e onde Pequim ainda parece Pequim. Isso tambem torna Nanluoguxiang redundante, e por isso ela foi cortada: mesma ideia de hutong, feita melhor e de graca.

items.address: Shichahai, Xicheng District · 西城区什刹海

text.en: Dinner around the lakes
text.pt: Jantar em volta dos lagos

note.en: Eat in the hutongs off the Houhai shore and go to bed early. The alarm tomorrow is 05:30 and that is not negotiable - it is the entire Wall strategy.
note.pt: Coma nos hutongs fora da margem do Houhai e durma cedo. O despertador de amanha e 5h30 e isso nao e negociavel - e a estrategia inteira da Muralha.

items.address: Shichahai, Xicheng District · 西城区什刹海

text.en: PLAN B (swap) - Jinshanling: empty, but NO toboggan
text.pt: PLANO B (troca) - Jinshanling: vazia, mas SEM toboga

note.en: If emptiness matters more than the toboggan, this replaces Plan A above - it is an either/or, not an addition, and it also eats the Drum Tower afternoon. Jinshanling is the real thing: 10.5 km, half-wild and half-restored, 67 watchtowers, 130 km from Beijing, known as the photographer's section precisely because almost nobody is on it. There IS a cable car (15 min up), so it is not a brutal climb. But there is no toboggan and there never will be - that is the whole trade. Private car about 2h each way, or high-speed rail to Gubeikou station then a Didi under 30 yuan to the gate. A direct bus also leaves Wangjing West metro at 08:00 and returns 15:00.
note.pt: Se o vazio importa mais que o toboga, isto substitui o Plano A acima - e um ou outro, nao um acrescimo, e tambem come a tarde do Drum Tower. Jinshanling e a coisa de verdade: 10,5 km, metade selvagem e metade restaurada, 67 torres de vigia, 130 km de Pequim, conhecida como a secao dos fotografos justamente porque quase ninguem esta nela. TEM teleferico (15 min ate o topo), entao nao e uma subida brutal. Mas nao tem toboga e nunca vai ter - essa e a troca inteira. Carro privado cerca de 2h cada trecho, ou trem de alta velocidade ate a estacao Gubeikou e depois um Didi por menos de 30 yuan ate o portao. Ha tambem um onibus direto que sai do metro Wangjing West as 08h00 e volta as 15h00.

items.address: HuaLouGou Village, Bakeshiying Town, Luanping County, Hebei · 河北省滦平县巴克什营镇花楼沟村 金山岭长城

note.en: Oct 25 (Sun) - Datong, the single biggest detour of the trip, and the one day whose shape is still open. The train is the easy part: 43 high-speed trains a day run from Qinghe or Beijing North to Datong South between 06:44 and 20:17, the fastest in 1h46, most around 2h. The hard part is that the two great sights sit far apart, so pick one of the three shapes below before you book anything. Whatever you choose, Datong South is where you land, and a driver waiting at the station is what makes the day work.
note.pt: 25/out (dom) - Datong, o maior desvio unico da viagem, e o unico dia cuja forma ainda esta aberta. O trem e a parte facil: 43 trens-bala por dia saem de Qinghe ou de Pequim Norte para Datong Sul entre 06:44 e 20:17, o mais rapido em 1h46, a maioria em torno de 2h. O dificil e que os dois grandes sitios ficam longe um do outro, entao escolha uma das tres formas abaixo antes de reservar qualquer coisa. Em qualquer caso voces desembarcam em Datong Sul, e o que faz o dia funcionar e um motorista esperando na estacao.

text.en: DECISION STILL OPEN - pick one of the three shapes
text.pt: DECISAO EM ABERTO - escolha uma das tres formas

note.en: SHAPE A, both sights with a hired car: Yungang first, lunch, then 1h30 across to the Hanging Temple. Out at 06:30, back near 22:00, about 15 hours door to door. SHAPE B, Yungang only: 20 min from the station, back in Beijing mid-afternoon, evening free. SHAPE C, Hanging Temple plus the Huayan Temple or Datong's earth wall, dropping the UNESCO caves.
note.pt: FORMA A, os dois com carro contratado: Yungang primeiro, almoco, depois 1h30 atravessando ate o Mosteiro Suspenso. Saida 06:30, volta perto das 22:00, uns 15 horas de porta a porta. FORMA B, so Yungang: 20 min da estacao, de volta a Pequim no meio da tarde, noite livre. FORMA C, Mosteiro Suspenso mais o Templo Huayan ou a muralha de terra de Datong, abrindo mao das grutas UNESCO.

text.en: Bullet train Qinghe or Beijing North to Datong South
text.pt: Trem-bala de Qinghe ou Pequim Norte ate Datong Sul

note.en: The high-speed train from Beijing North (北京北站) reaches Datong South (大同南站) in about 1h40 to 2h10, and several run through the morning. Leaving around 07:00 puts you at the first sight by mid-morning and leaves margin for the evening return. Confirm 2026 times on 12306 when sales open; Trilho to lock the exact train.
note.pt: O trem de alta velocidade de Beijing North (北京北站) chega a Datong South (大同南站) em cerca de 1h40 a 2h10, e varios saem ao longo da manha. Sair por volta das 07:00 te poe na primeira atracao no meio da manha e deixa margem para o retorno a noite. Confirme os horarios de 2026 no 12306 quando a venda abrir; o Trilho trava o trem exato.

text.en: Yungang Grottoes
text.pt: Grutas de Yungang

note.en: 51,000 Buddhas carved into 252 sandstone caves in the 5th century, some over 15 m tall, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of China's three great cave-temple complexes. About 16 km west of Datong, so it pairs with the drive back toward the station. Open roughly 08:30-17:00, ticket around CNY 120. Give it two hours minimum - the great central caves are worth slowing down for.
note.pt: 51.000 budas esculpidos em 252 cavernas de arenito no seculo V, alguns com mais de 15 m, um sitio do Patrimonio Mundial da UNESCO e um dos tres grandes complexos de grutas-templo da China. Cerca de 16 km a oeste de Datong, entao casa com a volta em direcao a estacao. Aberto mais ou menos das 8h30 as 17h, ingresso uns CNY 120. Reserve no minimo duas horas - as grandes cavernas centrais merecem que voce va devagar.

items.address: Yungang Grottoes, Cheng District, Datong, Shanxi · 山西省大同市城区 云冈石窟

text.en: Hanging Temple (Xuankong Si)
text.pt: Mosteiro Suspenso (Xuankong Si)

note.en: A monastery built into a cliff face 1,500 years ago, its halls held up by slender wooden posts over a 50 m drop, the only one of its kind. About an hour by car from Datong South. Around CNY 100 plus a climb ticket; the walkways are narrow and form a queue, so go before the tour groups. Pairing it with Yungang in one day is the standard Datong loop, but it is tight - keep moving.
note.pt: Um mosteiro encravado num paredao ha 1.500 anos, com os saloes sustentados por finos pilares de madeira sobre uma queda de 50 m, o unico do genero. Cerca de uma hora de carro de Datong South. Uns CNY 100 mais um bilhete de subida; as passarelas sao estreitas e formam fila, entao va antes dos grupos. Juntar com Yungang no mesmo dia e o circuito padrao de Datong, mas e apertado - nao pare muito.

items.address: Hunyuan County, Datong, Shanxi · 山西省大同市浑源县 悬空寺

text.en: Bullet train Datong South back to Beijing
text.pt: Trem-bala Datong Sul de volta a Pequim

note.en: Take an evening train back so the day is a true out-and-back: the last high-speed services leave Datong South around 19:00-20:00 and land you at Beijing North by roughly 21:00-22:00. Do not cut the return tight - book it together with the outbound. Tomorrow is only the morning train to Shanghai.
note.pt: Pegue um trem no comeco da noite para o dia ser um verdadeiro ida-e-volta: os ultimos servicos de alta velocidade saem de Datong South por volta das 19h-20h e te deixam em Beijing North la pelas 21h-22h. Nao aperte o retorno - reserve junto com a ida. Amanha e so o trem da manha para Shanghai.

note.en: Oct 26 (Mon) - Out of Beijing and into the base that carries the rest of the trip. The fast trains leave Beijing South early, G1 at 06:30 into Hongqiao at 11:24, and the quickest run of the day is 4h18, so by early afternoon you are checking into the room you will keep for five nights. Monday is the worst museum day in Shanghai and it does not matter: this afternoon is deliberately street level, a temple boxed in by towers, neon walked east, and the river lighting up.
note.pt: 26/out (seg) - Fora de Pequim e dentro da base que carrega o resto da viagem. Os trens rapidos saem de Pequim Sul cedo, o G1 as 06:30 chegando em Hongqiao as 11:24, e o mais rapido do dia faz 4h18, entao no comeco da tarde voces estao fazendo check-in no quarto que vao manter por cinco noites. Segunda e o pior dia de museu em Shanghai e nao faz diferenca: esta tarde e de proposito no nivel da rua, um templo encaixotado por torres, neon percorrido para leste e o rio se acendendo.

text.en: G-train Beijing South to Shanghai Hongqiao
text.pt: Trem G Beijing South ate Shanghai Hongqiao

note.en: The Beijing-Shanghai high-speed line runs about 4h30. Leave Beijing South mid-morning and you are in Shanghai Hongqiao by early afternoon, bags down by around 15:00. Book Beijing South (北京南), not West or North, and Shanghai Hongqiao, not the far-out Pudong.
note.pt: A linha de alta velocidade Pequim-Shanghai leva cerca de 4h30. Saindo de Beijing South no meio da manha voce esta em Shanghai Hongqiao no comeco da tarde, com as malas no hotel la pelas 15:00. Reserve Beijing South (北京南), nao West nem North, e Shanghai Hongqiao, nao o distante Pudong.

items.address: Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station · 上海虹桥站

text.en: Check in for five nights, one hotel
text.pt: Check-in de cinco noites, um hotel so

note.en: The whole point of this block: the same room from the 26th to the 31st, so Hangzhou and Suzhou cost a train ticket each and not a packed bag. Nothing is booked yet for these nights.
note.pt: A ideia inteira deste bloco: o mesmo quarto do dia 26 ao 31, para que Hangzhou e Suzhou custem uma passagem de trem cada e nao uma mala feita. Estas noites ainda nao estao reservadas.

text.en: Jing'an Temple
text.pt: Templo Jing'an

note.en: A gold-roofed Buddhist temple hemmed in by glass towers, which is the entire point of it. Small and quick, the only temple in either Shanghai block.
note.pt: Um templo budista de telhado dourado cercado por torres de vidro, que e justamente a graca dele. Pequeno e rapido, o unico templo dos dois blocos de Shanghai.

items.address: 1686 Nanjing West Road, Jing'an District · 上海市静安区南京西路1686号

text.en: Nanjing Road pedestrian street
text.pt: Rua de pedestres Nanjing Road

note.en: The loud neon shopping spine running east from Jing'an to the river. Not subtle and not trying to be, but it walks you to the Bund without a metro ride and lands you there exactly as the light drops.
note.pt: A espinha comercial de neon barulhento que corre para leste do Jing'an ate o rio. Nao e sutil e nem tenta ser, mas te leva ao Bund a pe, sem metro, e te deixa la exatamente quando a luz cai.

items.address: Nanjing East Road, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区南京东路步行街

text.en: The Bund lit up
text.pt: The Bund iluminado

note.en: You saw this jet-lagged on 12 Oct, three weeks and half a country ago; this time you can actually take it in. Lights come on around 18:30 and the whole river turns on at once. The right way to say you are back.
note.pt: Voce viu isto com jet-lag em 12/out, tres semanas e meio pais atras; desta vez da para aproveitar de verdade. As luzes acendem por volta das 18:30 e o rio inteiro se acende de uma vez. O jeito certo de dizer que voltou.

items.address: Zhongshan East 1st Road, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区中山东一路

note.en: Oct 27 (Tue) - Hangzhou, and the day is one hour of train each way, which is why it works as a day trip at all. The shape you picked: Lingyin and the Feilai Feng carvings first thing, while the temple still belongs to the monks, then lunch in the hills and the rest of the light on West Lake, walking the Su Causeway south to Leifeng for sunset. Dinner near Hefang Street and a late train home. One warning: this is the day with the most walking after Beijing.
note.pt: 27/out (ter) - Hangzhou, e o dia e uma hora de trem para cada lado, que e justamente o que faz o bate-volta funcionar. A forma que voce escolheu: Lingyin e as esculturas do Feilai Feng logo de manha, enquanto o templo ainda pertence aos monges, depois almoco nas colinas e o resto da luz no Lago Oeste, andando a Su Causeway para o sul ate o Leifeng no por do sol. Jantar perto da rua Hefang e trem tarde de volta. Um aviso: este e o dia de mais caminhada depois de Pequim.

text.en: G-train Shanghai Hongqiao to Hangzhou East
text.pt: Trem G Shanghai Hongqiao ate Hangzhou Leste

note.en: The easiest day trip in China: around 317 trains a day, every 5 to 15 min at peak, 34 min on the fastest and under an hour on most. First one leaves 04:08, so a 07:00 departure is trivial to get.
note.pt: O bate-volta mais facil da China: cerca de 317 trens por dia, a cada 5 a 15 min no pico, 34 min no mais rapido e menos de uma hora na maioria. O primeiro sai as 04:08, entao pegar um das 07:00 e trivial.

text.en: Lingyin Temple, first thing
text.pt: Templo Lingyin, logo de manha

note.en: The most important Buddhist temple in southern China, founded in 328, and the reason to come early: it opens 06:30 and closes 17:45 from October, and by 10:00 the incense crowd owns it. Metro line 1 to Longxiangqiao then bus 7, or 35 min by taxi from the station.
note.pt: O templo budista mais importante do sul da China, fundado em 328, e a razao para chegar cedo: abre as 06:30 e fecha as 17:45 a partir de outubro, e as 10:00 a multidao do incenso toma conta. Metro linha 1 ate Longxiangqiao e depois onibus 7, ou 35 min de taxi da estacao.

items.address: 1 Fayun Alley, Xihu District, Hangzhou · 杭州市西湖区法云弄1号

text.en: Feilai Feng, the carved grottoes
text.pt: Feilai Feng, as grutas esculpidas

note.en: Right at the temple gate, and the part people skip: over 300 Buddhist carvings cut into the limestone between the Five Dynasties and the Yuan. The Feilai Feng ticket is CNY 45 in peak season, and the temple itself is entered with a separate CNY 30 incense voucher.
note.pt: Colado no portao do templo, e a parte que as pessoas pulam: mais de 300 esculturas budistas talhadas no calcario entre as Cinco Dinastias e os Yuan. O ingresso do Feilai Feng e CNY 45 na alta temporada, e no templo em si se entra com um voucher de incenso separado de CNY 30.

text.en: Lunch in the hills, then down to the lake
text.pt: Almoco nas colinas, depois descer ate o lago

text.en: West Lake on the Su Causeway
text.pt: Lago Oeste pela Su Causeway

note.en: Su Dongpo built this 2.8 km bank out of dredged mud in 1090 and it is still the best way to be inside the lake rather than beside it: six bridges, willows, and the hills closing the far end. Walk it north to south, or rent a bike.
note.pt: Su Dongpo construiu esta margem de 2,8 km com a lama dragada em 1090 e ela segue sendo o melhor jeito de estar dentro do lago em vez de ao lado dele: seis pontes, salgueiros e as colinas fechando o fundo. Faca de norte a sul, a pe ou de bicicleta.

text.en: Leifeng Pagoda at sunset
text.pt: Pagode Leifeng no por do sol

note.en: The south end of the causeway, with a lift inside, and the one place that gives you the whole lake from above with the light going.
note.pt: A ponta sul da causeway, com elevador dentro, e o unico lugar que te da o lago inteiro de cima com a luz indo embora.

text.en: Hefang Street and dinner before the train
text.pt: Rua Hefang e jantar antes do trem

text.en: Back to Shanghai, last trains run late
text.pt: Volta a Shanghai, os ultimos trens sao tarde

note.en: Oct 28 (Wed) - Suzhou, 25 minutes away, and the only thing in this last stretch that is genuinely unlike anything else on the trip: scholar gardens, the form Chinese landscape painting was built to imitate. Wednesday matters, because the Suzhou Museum is closed on Mondays and needs a WeChat reservation up to 7 days ahead. Be on an early train, take the Humble Administrator's Garden at opening while it is still quiet, then Pei's museum next door, Tiger Hill, and Pingjiang Road as the lanterns come on. The night garden that used to justify sleeping here is suspended, so tonight you sleep in your own bed in Shanghai.
note.pt: 28/out (qua) - Suzhou, a 25 minutos, e a unica coisa deste trecho final que e de verdade diferente de tudo o mais na viagem: jardins de letrados, a forma que a pintura de paisagem chinesa foi feita para imitar. Quarta importa, porque o Museu de Suzhou fecha nas segundas e exige reserva pelo WeChat com ate 7 dias de antecedencia. Peguem um trem cedo, o Jardim do Administrador Humilde na abertura enquanto esta vazio, depois o museu do Pei ao lado, Tiger Hill e a rua Pingjiang quando as lanternas acendem. O jardim noturno que justificava dormir aqui esta suspenso, entao hoje voces dormem na propria cama em Shanghai.

text.en: G-train Shanghai Hongqiao to Suzhou, 25 min
text.pt: Trem G Shanghai Hongqiao ate Suzhou, 25 min

note.en: Over 450 pairs a day, 25 to 30 min, from CNY 21, first one 05:46 and the last one back just before 23:29. Trains land at Suzhou Station, 10 min from the gardens. Be on a 07:00 train and you are at the garden gate when it opens.
note.pt: Mais de 450 pares por dia, 25 a 30 min, a partir de CNY 21, o primeiro as 05:46 e o ultimo de volta pouco antes das 23:29. Os trens chegam a Suzhou Station, a 10 min dos jardins. Peguem um trem das 07:00 e voces estao no portao do jardim na abertura.

items.address: Suzhou Railway Station · 苏州站

text.en: Humble Administrator's Garden
text.pt: Jardim do Administrador Humilde

note.en: The largest and most important classical garden in China, a UNESCO site, and the reason to come to Suzhou at all. CNY 70, open 07:30 to 17:30. The timed entry slot is mandatory and is not sold at the gate, so book the earliest slot you can get.
note.pt: O maior e mais importante jardim classico da China, Patrimonio da UNESCO, e a razao de se ir a Suzhou. CNY 70, aberto 07:30 as 17:30. O slot de horario e obrigatorio e nao se vende na porta, entao reserve o slot mais cedo que conseguir.

items.address: 178 Dongbei Street, Gusu District · 苏州市姑苏区东北街178号

text.en: Suzhou Museum, by I.M. Pei
text.pt: Museu de Suzhou, de I.M. Pei

note.en: Pei was 85, born to a Suzhou family, and built this next door to the garden as his answer to it: white walls, grey stone, a courtyard pond, and a rock garden framed like a scroll. Free, open Tuesday to Sunday 09:00 to 17:00 with last entry 16:00, closed Mondays, and you must reserve on the official WeChat mini-program up to 7 days ahead.
note.pt: Pei tinha 85 anos, era de uma familia de Suzhou, e construiu isto ao lado do jardim como a sua resposta a ele: paredes brancas, pedra cinza, um espelho de agua no patio e um jardim de pedras enquadrado como um pergaminho. Gratuito, aberto de terca a domingo das 09:00 as 17:00 com ultima entrada as 16:00, fechado nas segundas, e e obrigatorio reservar no mini-programa oficial do WeChat com ate 7 dias de antecedencia.

items.address: 204 Dongbei Street, Gusu, Suzhou · 苏州市姑苏区东北街204号

text.en: Tiger Hill and the leaning pagoda
text.pt: Tiger Hill e o pagode inclinado

note.en: Lunch, then about 20 minutes northwest by taxi. A wooded hill topped by the Yunyan Pagoda, seven storeys of brick and wood from 959 AD, tilted three degrees because the ground under one side gave way, and standing anyway for a thousand years. Su Dongpo wrote that it is a shame to visit Suzhou and skip it. CNY 70 April to October, open 07:30 to 18:00, last entry 17:30. Not a garden and not a canal, which is exactly why it is here.
note.pt: Almoce e depois uns 20 minutos a noroeste de taxi. Uma colina arborizada coroada pelo Pagode Yunyan, sete andares de tijolo e madeira de 959 d.C., inclinado tres graus porque o solo cedeu de um lado, e de pe assim mesmo ha mil anos. Su Dongpo escreveu que e uma vergonha visitar Suzhou e pular isto. CNY 70 de abril a outubro, aberto das 07:30 as 18:00, ultima entrada 17:30. Nao e jardim e nao e canal, que e exatamente por que esta aqui.

items.address: 8 Huqiu Hill Gate, Gusu District · 苏州市姑苏区虎丘山门内8号

text.en: Pingjiang Road at dusk, and dinner
text.pt: Rua Pingjiang no fim da tarde, e jantar

note.en: Back east, about 25 minutes. A canal lined with stone bridges and old houses, where Suzhou stops being a ticket and turns back into a city. Free. Sunset lands around 17:10, and there is plenty to eat along it before the garden.
note.pt: De volta para leste, uns 25 minutos. Um canal ladeado de pontes de pedra e casas antigas, onde Suzhou deixa de ser ingresso e volta a ser cidade. Gratuito. O por do sol cai por volta das 17:10, e ha bastante o que comer ao longo dele antes do jardim.

items.address: Pingjiang Road, Gusu District · 苏州市姑苏区平江路

text.en: ONLY IF IT REOPENS - Master of the Nets Night Garden
text.pt: SO SE REABRIR - Jardim Noturno do Master of the Nets

note.en: Kunqu opera, pingtan storytelling and guzheng staged courtyard by courtyard in an 800-year-old garden after dark, CNY 120, tickets on the 苏州园林旅游 WeChat account. It was suspended on 9 Aug 2026 after a typhoon with no reopening date announced, and one source says it runs only Fridays and Saturdays. Check before you count on it; if it is running, the last train back is 23:29.
note.pt: Opera Kunqu, narrativa pingtan e guzheng encenados patio a patio num jardim de 800 anos depois do escuro, CNY 120, ingressos na conta WeChat 苏州园林旅游. Foi suspenso em 9/ago/2026 depois de um tifao, sem data de retorno, e uma fonte diz que so roda sexta e sabado. Confirme antes de contar com ele; se estiver rodando, o ultimo trem de volta e as 23:29.

items.address: 11 Kuojiatou Alley, Gusu District · 苏州市姑苏区阔家头巷11号

note.en: 28 Oct, Wednesday, and the most walkable day of the whole trip. It opens with the one thing this itinerary was completely missing: not a monument, but everyday Chinese life. At 08:00 a French park from 1909 in the middle of the old Concession fills with people ballroom dancing, doing tai chi, playing mahjong and, genuinely, playing saxophone. Nobody is performing for you. Then plane trees and art deco, alleys after lunch, and at night acrobats, because in three weeks of temples, karsts and gardens this trip has never once watched anything happen on a stage. Tomorrow you go to Suzhou rested, which was the entire argument for arranging it this way.
note.pt: 28/out, quarta, e o dia mais a pe da viagem inteira. Ele abre com a unica coisa que faltava por completo neste roteiro: nao um monumento, mas a vida chinesa cotidiana. As 08:00 um parque frances de 1909 no meio da antiga Concessao se enche de gente dancando valsa, fazendo tai chi, jogando mahjong e, de verdade, tocando saxofone. Ninguem esta se apresentando para voce. Depois platanos e art deco, vielas apos o almoco, e a noite acrobatas, porque em tres semanas de templos, karsts e jardins esta viagem nunca viu nada acontecer num palco. Amanha voce vai a Suzhou descansado, que era o argumento inteiro para arrumar as coisas assim.

text.en: Fuxing Park at morning exercise hour
text.pt: Fuxing Park na hora do exercicio matinal

note.en: The only well-preserved French-style park in China, laid out in 1909, and for a century the backyard of the shikumen lanes around it. Come at 08:00 and it is full of ballroom dancers, tai chi circles, card and mahjong tables and amateur musicians. Locals may well wave you into a waltz. Free, open 05:00 to 21:00. This is the trip's only unstaged look at how the city actually lives.
note.pt: O unico parque de estilo frances bem preservado da China, desenhado em 1909, e ha um seculo o quintal das vielas shikumen ao redor. Chegue as 08:00 e ele esta cheio de dancarinos de salao, rodas de tai chi, mesas de carta e mahjong e musicos amadores. E bem possivel que te chamem para uma valsa. Gratuito, aberto das 05:00 as 21:00. E o unico olhar sem encenacao da viagem sobre como a cidade de fato vive.

items.address: 2 Gaolan Road, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区皋兰路2号

text.en: Wukang Road
text.pt: Rua Wukang

note.en: Fifteen minutes west of the park. Plane trees and 1920s villas along the old French Concession. The best walk in the city, and it costs nothing. Morning light through the trees is the whole reason to do it now.
note.pt: Quinze minutos a oeste do parque. Platanos e vilas dos anos 1920 pela antiga Concessao Francesa. A melhor caminhada da cidade, e nao custa nada. A luz da manha entre as arvores e a razao inteira de fazer isso agora.

items.address: Wukang Road, Xuhui District · 上海市徐汇区武康路

text.en: Wukang Mansion
text.pt: Edificio Wukang

note.en: The 1924 Hudec building that gives the street its photograph, wedged into an acute corner like a liner coming straight at you. It sits at the end of the walk, so you arrive without planning to.
note.pt: O predio de 1924 de Hudec que da a foto da rua, encaixado numa esquina aguda como um transatlantico vindo em cima de voce. Fica na ponta da caminhada, entao voce chega nele sem planejar.

items.address: 1850 Huaihai Middle Road, Xuhui District · 上海市徐汇区淮海中路1850号

text.en: Tianzifang
text.pt: Tianzifang

note.en: Lunch in the Concession, then twenty minutes east. Shikumen stone-gate alleys turned into studios and cafes, tangled enough that getting lost is the activity. Touristy and worth it anyway.
note.pt: Almoce na Concessao e depois vinte minutos para leste. Vielas shikumen viradas ateliês e cafes, emaranhadas o bastante para que se perder seja a atracao. Turistico e vale mesmo assim.

items.address: Lane 210 Taikang Road, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区泰康路210弄

text.en: ERA acrobatic show at Shanghai Circus World
text.pt: Espetaculo acrobatico ERA no Shanghai Circus World

note.en: Chinese acrobatics is a 2,000-year-old discipline and Shanghai's troupe is the one that matters. Contortion, pole work, and the finale with motorcycles inside a steel sphere. Nightly at 19:30 except Mondays, 60 minutes on weekdays, CNY 280 to 880. Book ahead; the venue is about 35 minutes north by metro, so eat before.
note.pt: A acrobacia chinesa e uma disciplina de 2.000 anos e a trupe de Shanghai e a que importa. Contorcionismo, mastro chines e o final com motocicletas dentro de uma esfera de aco. Todas as noites as 19:30 exceto segunda, 60 minutos em dias de semana, CNY 280 a 880. Reserve antes; o teatro fica uns 35 minutos ao norte de metro, entao jante antes.

items.address: 2266 Gonghexin Road, Jing'an District · 上海市静安区共和新路2266号

note.en: Oct 30 (Fri) - The last day, and the one the whole calendar was protecting. Yu Garden was shut on the Monday you arrived, so 09:00 sharp today is the calm, unhurried slot the trip saved for it. Garden first while it is empty, the bazaar that wraps its gate, then cross the Huangpu the way the city crosses it, on the locals' 2 yuan ferry rather than a tour boat, and end high: Shanghai Tower at sunset. Pack tonight, not tomorrow. The flight is Saturday at 10:55, check-in closes 09:55, and you leave the hotel 06:45.
note.pt: 30/out (sex) - O ultimo dia, e aquele que o calendario inteiro vinha protegendo. O Yu Garden estava fechado na segunda em que voces chegaram, entao hoje as 09:00 em ponto e o encaixe calmo e sem pressa que a viagem guardou para ele. Jardim primeiro enquanto esta vazio, o bazar que envolve o portao dele, depois atravessem o Huangpu como a cidade o atravessa, na balsa de 2 yuan dos moradores e nao num barco de turismo, e terminem no alto: Shanghai Tower no por do sol. Facam a mala hoje, nao amanha. O voo e sabado as 10:55, o check-in fecha as 09:55, e voces saem do hotel as 06:45.

text.en: Yu Garden
text.pt: Yu Garden

note.en: The real Ming classical garden: rockeries, ponds and dragon walls folded into a space far smaller than it feels. Closed on Mondays, which took it from you on the 12th when you landed, so this is the slot the trip saved for it. CNY 40 in October, 09:00 to 16:30. Arrive at opening and you get it nearly empty.
note.pt: O verdadeiro jardim classico Ming: rochedos, lagos e muros de dragao dobrados num espaco bem menor do que parece. Fecha as segundas, o que te tirou ele em 12/out quando voce chegou, entao este e o encaixe que a viagem guardou para ele. CNY 40 em outubro, 09:00 as 16:30. Chegue na abertura e voce o pega quase vazio.

items.address: 218 Anren Street, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区安仁街218号

text.en: Nanshi Old Town and Yuyuan Bazaar
text.pt: Nanshi Old Town e Bazar Yuyuan

note.en: The bazaar wraps around the garden gate, so you walk straight out into it: food stalls, silk, tea and the teahouse on the zigzag bridge. You saw this jet-lagged on 12 Oct with the garden shut; now the two halves finally fit together. Free.
note.pt: O bazar envolve o portao do jardim, entao voce sai direto nele: barracas de comida, seda, cha e a casa de cha da ponte em ziguezague. Voce viu isto com jet-lag em 12/out, com o jardim fechado; agora as duas metades finalmente se encaixam. Gratuito.

items.address: Yuyuan Old Street, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区豫园老街

text.en: Huangpu ferry, Jinling Road to Dongchang Road
text.pt: Balsa do Huangpu, Jinling Road ate Dongchang Road

note.en: Lunch near the Old Town, then the best two yuan in Shanghai. The Dongjin line is a commuter ferry, not a tour boat: locals with bicycles and shopping crossing to work, ten minutes on the open deck with the Bund behind you and Lujiazui coming at you. Runs roughly 07:00 to 18:30. It is also simply how you get to Pudong today.
note.pt: Almoce perto da Old Town e depois gaste os melhores dois yuan de Shanghai. A linha Dongjin e balsa de travessia, nao barco de turismo: moradores com bicicleta e compras indo trabalhar, dez minutos no deck aberto com o Bund atras de voce e Lujiazui vindo na sua direcao. Opera mais ou menos das 07:00 as 18:30. E tambem simplesmente como voce vai a Pudong hoje.

items.address: Jinling East Road Ferry Terminal, Huangpu District · 上海市黄浦区金陵东路渡口

text.en: Optional - Shanghai Museum East, in Pudong
text.pt: Opcional - Shanghai Museum East, em Pudong

note.en: If the last day wants an indoor hour, this is the one: the new wing of the Shanghai Museum, 10:00 to 18:00 with last entry 17:00, closed on TUESDAYS, by reservation on the museum site. It sits on the way to Lujiazui, so it fits before the tower.
note.pt: Se o ultimo dia pedir uma hora coberta, e esta: a ala nova do Museu de Shanghai, 10:00 as 18:00 com ultima entrada as 17:00, fechada nas TERCAS, com reserva no site do museu. Fica no caminho de Lujiazui, entao encaixa antes da torre.

items.address: 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong · 上海市浦东新区世纪大道1952号

text.en: Lujiazui
text.pt: Lujiazui

note.en: The ferry lands you at Dongchang Road, a short walk from the towers. The skyline you have been photographing from the Bund all trip, now seen from underneath. Walk the elevated ring between the three towers, with time to spare before the slot.
note.pt: A balsa te deixa na Dongchang Road, a uma curta caminhada das torres. O skyline que voce fotografou do Bund a viagem inteira, agora visto de baixo. Percorra o anel elevado entre as tres torres, com tempo sobrando antes do horario marcado.

items.address: Lujiazui, Pudong New Area · 上海市浦东新区陆家嘴

text.en: Shanghai Tower at sunset
text.pt: Shanghai Tower no por do sol

note.en: Floor 118 of the tallest building in China, and the right way to end 21 days. Sunset is 17:05, so a 16:15 slot buys you the city in daylight, at golden hour and fully lit, and you come down in the dark. CNY 180, open 08:30 to 21:30. Allow 30 minutes for security. The sunset slot fills, book ahead.
note.pt: O 118o andar do predio mais alto da China, e o jeito certo de encerrar 21 dias. O por do sol e as 17:05, entao um slot as 16:15 te da a cidade de dia, na hora dourada e toda iluminada, e voce desce no escuro. CNY 180, aberto 08:30 as 21:30. Conte 30 minutos para a seguranca. O slot do por do sol enche, reserve antes.

note.pt: Saia do hotel 06:45–07:00. O check-in do BA0168 fecha às 09:55, uma hora antes da partida. A conexão de 4h15 em Heathrow T5 é confortável.

dining.name: Fu He Hui 福和慧

note.pt: Duas estrelas MICHELIN para um menu degustacao vegetariano sazonal, num ambiente zen: sem carne e sem concessao.

dining.name: Jian Guo 328 建国328

note.en: A converted lane house in the old French Concession serving the Shanghainese classics MSG-free, at neighbourhood prices.
note.pt: Casa de vila reformada na antiga concessao francesa, servindo os classicos shanghaineses sem glutamato e a preco de bairro.

dining.address: 328 Jianguo West Road, Xuhui · 上海市徐汇区建国西路328号

dining.name: Jia Jia Tang Bao 佳家汤包

note.en: Family-run since 1986 and a Bib Gourmand regular: eighteen folds, paper-thin skin, pork-and-crab filling, always a queue.
note.pt: Familiar desde 1986 e habitue do Bib Gourmand: dezoito dobras, massa fininha, recheio de porco com caranguejo e fila na porta.

dining.address: 90 Huanghe Road, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区黄河路90号

dining.name: Canton 8 喜粤8号 (Runan Street)

note.en: Widely called the world's cheapest two-MICHELIN-star table: Chef Mak's 40 years of Cantonese classics and handmade dim sum in a casual room.
note.pt: Chamada de a mesa com duas estrelas MICHELIN mais barata do mundo: 40 anos de classicos cantoneses do chef Mak e dim sum feito a mao, num salao descontraido.

dining.address: 63 Runan Street, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区汝南街63号

dining.name: Fu 1088 福1088

note.en: Shanghainese cooking served in a restored 1928 Spanish villa where every table is its own private room — the city's most atmospheric dinner.
note.pt: Cozinha shanghainesa servida numa vila espanhola de 1928 restaurada, onde cada mesa e uma sala privativa: o jantar de atmosfera mais bonita da cidade.

dining.address: 375 Zhenning Road, Changning · 上海市长宁区镇宁路375号

dining.name: Lost Heaven on the Bund 花马天堂

note.en: Yunnan cooking with Burmese and Thai accents in a dark, ornate room a block off the Bund — and a rooftop terrace for drinks after.
note.pt: Cozinha de Yunnan com sotaque birmanes e tailandes num salao escuro e ornamentado a um quarteirao do Bund, com terraco na cobertura para o drink depois.

dining.address: 17 Yan'an East Road, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区延安东路17号

dining.name: Da Hu Chun 大壶春

note.en: Open since 1932 and Bib Gourmand listed: the old-school leavened shengjianbao, fluffy on top and lacquer-crisp on the bottom.
note.pt: Aberta desde 1932 e listada no Bib Gourmand: o shengjianbao de massa fermentada a moda antiga, fofo em cima e crocante feito laca embaixo.

dining.address: 136 Middle Sichuan Road, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区四川中路136号

dining.name: Taian Table 泰安门

note.en: Shanghai's only three-MICHELIN-star kitchen: a counter around the open pass, a menu that changes every few weeks and an all-German wine list.
note.pt: A unica cozinha com tres estrelas MICHELIN de Shanghai: um balcao ao redor do pass aberto, menu que muda a cada poucas semanas e carta so de vinhos alemaes.

dining.address: 101-102, Bldg 1, Garden Office, 161 Lane 465 Zhenning Road, Changning · 上海市长宁区镇宁路465弄161号1号楼101-102室

dining.name: Meet The Bund 遇外滩

note.en: Ranked No. 6 on Asia's 50 Best 2026 and named best restaurant in mainland China — modern Fujian cooking fifty-six floors above the river.
note.pt: Sexto lugar no Asia's 50 Best 2026 e eleito o melhor restaurante da China continental: cozinha de Fujian moderna a cinquenta e seis andares acima do rio.

dining.address: 56F, West Tower, Raffles City The Bund, Hongkou · 上海市虹口区北外滩来福士西塔56层

dining.name: Guyi Hunan 古意湘味浓 (Fumin Road)

note.en: The French Concession institution for unapologetically fiery Hunan food — the cumin-crusted ribs are the reason people queue past 18h30.
note.pt: A instituicao da concessao francesa para a comida hunanesa ardida sem pedir desculpa: a costela crocante de cominho e o motivo da fila depois das 18h30.

dining.address: 1F, May Fair Tower, 87 Fumin Road, Jing'an · 上海市静安区富民路87号

dining.name: Wei Xiang Zhai 味香斋

note.en: Open since 1937 and a repeat Bib Gourmand: a bowl of sesame-peanut noodles with spicy pork and a side of clear beef broth, eaten elbow to elbow.
note.pt: Aberta desde 1937 e Bib Gourmand repetido: uma tigela de macarrao no gergelim com amendoim e porco apimentado, com caldo claro de boi, comida cotovelo a cotovelo.

dining.address: 14 Yandang Road, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区雁荡路14号

dining.name: Lai Lai Xiao Long 莱莱小笼

note.en: A twenty-year alley institution near Nanjing Road and a Bib Gourmand pick: paper-thin skins, generous broth and pork-and-crab-roe baskets, open 8h to 20h.
note.pt: Instituicao de vinte anos num beco perto da Nanjing Road e escolha do Bib Gourmand: massa fininha, caldo generoso e cestas de porco com ova de caranguejo, aberta das 8h as 20h.

dining.address: 506 Tianjin Road, Huangpu · 上海市黄浦区天津路506号

dining.name: Da Dong 大董 (Jinbao Place)

note.en: The most famous modern take on Peking duck: leaner 22-day birds, carved tableside, plated like fine dining.
note.pt: A releitura moderna mais famosa do pato laqueado: aves de 22 dias, menos gordurosas, cortadas na mesa e empratadas como alta gastronomia.

dining.address: 5F, Jinbao Place, 88 Jinbao Street, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区金宝街88号金宝汇购物中心5层

dining.name: Siji Minfu 四季民福 (Wangfujing / Dong'anmen)

cuisine.pt: Pato laqueado, comida caseira de Pequim

note.en: Beijing's best value roast duck, minutes from the Forbidden City — go early or expect a long ticketed queue.
note.pt: O melhor custo-beneficio de pato laqueado, a minutos da Cidade Proibida. Va cedo ou conte com fila longa por senha.

dining.address: Dong'anmen Dajie, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区东安门大街

dining.name: No. 69 Fangzhuanchang Zhajiangmian 方砖厂69号炸酱面

cuisine.pt: Zhajiangmian (macarrao no molho de soja com porco)

note.en: A Bib Gourmand hutong counter with one dish only — the city's benchmark bowl of zhajiangmian, noodles and sauce refilled free.
note.pt: Balcao de hutong com Bib Gourmand e um prato so: a tigela de referencia de zhajiangmian em Pequim, com macarrao e molho de graca a vontade.

dining.address: Fangzhuanchang Hutong, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区方砖厂胡同

dining.name: Xin Rong Ji 新荣记 (Xinyuan South Road)

note.en: The flagship of the first mainland Chinese restaurant to hold three MICHELIN stars, built on East China Sea fish and a pre-order 28-day baby duck.
note.pt: A casa-mae do primeiro restaurante da China continental com tres estrelas MICHELIN, construida sobre peixes do mar da China Oriental e um pato de 28 dias sob encomenda.

dining.address: 1F, East Tower, Genesis Beijing, 8 Xinyuan South Road, Chaoyang · 北京市朝阳区新源南路8号启皓北京东塔1层

dining.name: TRB Hutong

note.en: One MICHELIN star served in the courtyard of a 600-year-old temple — the rare Beijing fine-dining room where the setting matches the plate.
note.pt: Uma estrela MICHELIN servida no patio de um templo de 600 anos: a rara sala de alta gastronomia em Pequim onde o cenario esta a altura do prato.

dining.address: 23 Shatan North Street, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区沙滩北街23号

dining.name: Najia Xiaoguan 那家小馆

cuisine.en: Manchu and Qing court home cooking
cuisine.pt: Caseira manchu e da corte Qing

note.en: Manchu recipes traced to 1748 in a lantern-lit courtyard — order the huang tanzi, a pot simmered eighteen hours, and the braised venison.
note.pt: Receitas manchus que remontam a 1748 num patio iluminado por lanternas. Peca o huang tanzi, uma panela cozida por dezoito horas, e o veado braseado.

dining.address: 10 Yong'anxili, Jianguomenwai, Chaoyang · 北京市朝阳区建国门外永安里10号

dining.name: Jubaoyuan 聚宝源 (Niujie)

note.en: Seventy years of copper-pot mutton on Beijing's Muslim quarter street: hand-cut lamb, sesame paste dip and the best sesame buns in town.
note.pt: Setenta anos de carneiro na panela de cobre na rua do bairro muculmano de Pequim: cordeiro cortado a mao, molho de gergelim e os melhores paezinhos de gergelim da cidade.

dining.address: Niujie Xili, Xicheng · 北京市西城区牛街西里

dining.name: King's Joy 京兆尹

note.en: A MICHELIN Green Star vegetarian tasting menu, all ingredients sourced in China, in a courtyard directly opposite the Lama Temple.
note.pt: Um menu degustacao vegetariano com Estrela Verde MICHELIN, todos os ingredientes vindos da China, num patio bem em frente ao Templo dos Lamas.

dining.address: 2 Wudaoying Hutong, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区五道营胡同2号

dining.name: Chuan Ban 川办餐厅

note.en: The canteen of the Sichuan provincial government office, so the chillies are not toned down — shuizhuyu and lazi ji as they are cooked back home.
note.pt: O refeitorio do escritorio do governo provincial de Sichuan, entao a pimenta nao vem suavizada: shuizhuyu e lazi ji como se fazem la na terra.

dining.address: 5 Gongyuan Toutiao, Jianguomennei Dajie, Dongcheng · 北京市东城区建国门内大街贡院头条5号

dining.name: Huguosi Snacks 护国寺小吃

cuisine.pt: Petiscos e doces tradicionais de Pequim

note.en: Eighty-odd old Beijing snacks under one roof, descended from a Qing temple fair — go for wandouhuang, aiwowo and a bowl of douzhi if you dare.
note.pt: Mais de oitenta petiscos da velha Pequim sob o mesmo teto, herdados de uma feira de templo Qing. Va pelo wandouhuang, pelo aiwowo e, se tiver coragem, pelo douzhi.

dining.address: Huguosi Street, Xicheng · 北京市西城区护国寺大街

dining.name: Yaoji Chaogan 姚记炒肝 (Gulou)

cuisine.pt: Chaogan (ensopado de miudos de porco com alho), baozi

note.en: The Drum Tower counter where breakfast starts at six: a bowl of glossy garlic-heavy chaogan and pork buns, famously eaten by a visiting US vice-president.
note.pt: O balcao da Torre do Tambor onde o cafe da manha comeca as seis: uma tigela de chaogan brilhante e carregado de alho com paezinhos de porco, comida celebre de um vice-presidente americano em visita.

dining.address: Gulou East Street, Dongcheng (below the Drum Tower) · 北京市东城区鼓楼东大街

dining.name: Fenglinge 凤临阁

note.en: Datong's culinary landmark: a lavishly carved Ming-style pavilion by Huayan Temple, famous for its hundred-flower shaomai.
note.pt: O marco gastronomico de Datong: um pavilhao estilo Ming ricamente entalhado ao lado do Templo Huayan, famoso pelo shaomai das cem flores.

dining.address: Gulou West Street, Pingcheng District (near Huayan Temple) · 山西省大同市平城区鼓楼西街

dining.name: Dongfang Xiaomian 东方削面

note.en: The local chain everyone in Datong eats at: knife-shaved noodles thick in the middle, thin at the edge, in lamb or beef broth.
note.pt: A rede local onde todo mundo em Datong come: macarrao cortado a faca, grosso no meio e fino nas bordas, em caldo de carneiro ou boi.

dining.name: Tang Shifu Tujia Shifu 唐师傅土家食府

note.en: The tidiest sit-down Tujia kitchen in Wulingyuan — smoked pork, fragrant-leaf duck and chopped-chilli fish head, spice level to order.
note.pt: A cozinha tujia mais caprichada de Wulingyuan: carne defumada, pato na folha aromatica e cabeca de peixe com pimenta picada, com a ardencia sob encomenda.

dining.name: Hu Shifu Sanxiaguo 胡师傅三下锅

cuisine.pt: Sanxiaguo (panela seca tujia tres em um)

note.en: The name locals give when you ask where to eat sanxiaguo — offal, smoked meat and vegetables simmered in one fiery pot.
note.pt: O nome que o local da quando voce pergunta onde comer sanxiaguo: miudos, carne defumada e legumes fervendo numa panela ardida so.

dining.name: Liu Xiaoqing Mi Doufu 刘晓庆米豆腐店

cuisine.pt: Mi doufu (tofu de arroz), petiscos de Xiangxi

note.en: The very shop actress Liu Xiaoqing ran in the film Hibiscus Town — a bowl of chilli-and-garlic rice tofu on the old stone street.
note.pt: A propria loja que a atriz Liu Xiaoqing tocou no filme Hibiscus Town: uma tigela de tofu de arroz com pimenta e alho na velha rua de pedra.

dining.name: Luna @ Yangshuo Village Inn 听月楼

note.en: The area's most romantic table: a rooftop facing Moon Hill, wood-fired pizza and an imported wine list — book for sunset.
note.pt: A mesa mais romantica da regiao: uma cobertura de frente para a Moon Hill, pizza de forno a lenha e carta de vinhos importados. Reserve para o por do sol.

dining.name: Liujie Beer Fish 六姐啤酒鱼

note.en: Li River carp braised whole with beer, tomato and chilli — the local dish, done by the family that treats it as heritage.
note.pt: Carpa do rio Li refogada inteira com cerveja, tomate e pimenta: o prato local, feito pela familia que o trata como patrimonio.

dining.name: Chongshan Mifen 崇善米粉

note.en: Guilin's breakfast institution: rice noodles under crisp pork and braised beef, free refills of pickles and broth for a few yuan.
note.pt: A instituicao do cafe da manha de Guilin: macarrao de arroz com porco crocante e carne cozida, com conservas e caldo a vontade por poucos yuan.

dining.name: Pingjiangsong 平江颂

note.en: One MICHELIN star inside a restored mansion and garden in the Pingjiang quarter — seasonal Suzhou cooking with a light modern hand.
note.pt: Uma estrela MICHELIN dentro de um casario e jardim restaurados no bairro Pingjiang: cozinha sazonal de Suzhou com uma mao moderna e leve.

dining.name: Songhelou 松鹤楼 (Guanqian)

note.en: Open since 1737 and the home of squirrel-shaped mandarin fish — the one historic Suzhou dining room worth the tourist crowd.
note.pt: Aberto desde 1737 e a casa do peixe esquilo agridoce: a unica sala historica de Suzhou que compensa encarar a multidao de turistas.

dining.name: Tong De Xing 同得兴 (Jiayu Fang)

note.en: Bib Gourmand noodle house open only until early afternoon — the clear white broth and Fengzhen pork noodles are the reason to set an alarm.
note.pt: Casa de macarrao com Bib Gourmand aberta so ate o inicio da tarde: o caldo claro e o macarrao de porco Fengzhen valem o despertador.
